meaning: even more; to a greater extent; all the more
usage: 更加 is an adverb used to indicate a higher degree or greater extent.
It is often used when comparing a current situation with a previous one, meaning even more than before.
It commonly appears before adjectives or verbs to emphasise that something increases or becomes stronger.

examples.sentence: 天氣凍咗，今晚會更加凍。
